about.headline: Handcrafted with strength. Rooted in purpose.
about.body: House of the Wild Bloom was built around the belief that self-care should feel personal, beautiful, and intentional. Every product is created in small batches with ingredients that have a reason for being there — no filler, no fluff, just thoughtful ritual care.
about.body2: From facial rituals and body butters to gift sets and candles, the goal is simple: create products that work, look beautiful, and make everyday care feel meaningful.
